scope: Only formulas/meanings already grouped under the SAME searchable term in the compiled 2026-10-27 staging catalog. No cross-heading synonyms or new candidate search.

classification_policy.obvious_duplicate: Same mathematical predicate/construction with only cosmetic or explanatory differences; merge redundant formulation and union all source references.
classification_policy.obviously_mathematically_distinct: Different mathematical input structures, parameter domains, handedness, field/ring conventions, or other explicitly distinct mathematical definitions; preserve both.
classification_policy.manual_review: Equivalent but substantially different characterizations, substantive boundary/convention differences, or any remaining potential overlap; do not merge without user review.
